The notes define \(T(n)\) as an upper bound on expected running time for an array of size \(n\). The work comprises sorting the left subarray, sorting the right subarray, and the expected number of pivot attempts needed to obtain a good call. A partition step costs \(cn\).
A good pivot occurs with probability greater than \(1/2\). Therefore, the expected number of attempts is at most \(2\):
E[\#\text{iterations}] \leq 2.
The recurrence displayed on the page is:
T(n) \leq \max_{n/4 \leq i \leq 3n/4} \left(T(i) + T(n-i)\right) + E[\#\text{iterations}] \cdot cn.
